SourceFile
  RootPackage
    @CLayout(aligned = 8, packed = 1)
  struct Packed
    field value: Int8
    field flag: Boolean
  enum Choice
    Data(Packed)
    Text(String)
    Empty
  struct Wrapper
    field choice: Choice
  struct Unused
    field ignored: ULong
    @Extern(name = "native_mixed", abi = "scoop", lib = "m23_native_boundary")
  fun nativeMixed(value: Wrapper, i8: Int8, i16: Int16, i32: Int, i64: Long, u8: UInt8, u16: UInt16, u32: UInt, u64: ULong)
